notes.text: On the sheet headed 22, the author says that the MD condition still has to be verified for the maquette obtained. He derives connectivity from that of the primed graph and writes the numerical inequality 2g plus the two displayed cardinalities at least 3. The term in both live type assertions is anabélien. He describes the local maquette through the connected component of G-prime-bullet and its marked-point projection, then invokes the proposition of no. 3 and ends with an unfinished universal condition. This is a report of the page’s statements, not verification of the argument. The overwritten set letters, cancelled superscript and final replaced index remain uncertain in the transcription.

The local projection label is read as baseline I(alpha), and the subsequent inline I-prime/S-prime connection has a shaft with a downward terminal curl; root retains uncertainty between a literal shaft and a compressed arrowhead. The full display above it does have an arrowhead. The uncertain de/membership cluster may involve an overwrite, but no independent cancellation boundary is asserted. A pale pencil 45 is present at the lower left; neither that number nor the dark heading 22 is assigned an owner from this page alone. The apparent rule under signifie is the continuous leftward return of its g-descender.
